extracted.intended_audience: CIA Personnel Division and Legislative Liaison Division staff; agency personnel processing congressional personnel references for employment
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative procedure for handling congressional calls/communications about personnel and applicants referred to the agency for employment consideration, including referral, interview, processing, communication, and timing requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate referral to Legislative Liaison Division
rubrics_metrics.description: All congressional calls and communications in connection with personnel matters will, immediately upon receipt, be referred to the Legislative Liaison Division of the Personnel and Administrative Branch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the primary intake rule: any congressional communication about personnel must be routed to Legislative Liaison without delay so that standardized handling and tracking can occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request submission of Form 57 or applicant interview
rubrics_metrics.description: Request the congressional office concerned to either submit forms 57 for consideration or send applicant to that division for interview. Applicant should bring Form 57 with him.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legislative Liaison should solicit a completed Form 57 as the standard application document; if the applicant is sent in person, ensure they bring Form 57 to permit evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrange Personnel Procurement interview when qualifications indicated
rubrics_metrics.description: If examination of the Form 57 or result of interview indicates that applicant may possess qualifications currently needed by CIG, the Chief of the Legislative Liaison Division will arrange for an interview with the Chief of the Personnel .Procurement Section or his deputy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Form 57/interview result to screen for positions of current need; arrange higher-level interview only where indicated by qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure when no special qualifications of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: If examination of Form 57 or result of interview indicates no special qualifications of immediate interest to CIG, the applicant will be informed that his Form 57 will be reviewed and decision as to employment furnished him within two weeks. In such case no further interview will be arranged, but Form 57 will be forwarded to the Chief of the Personnel Division for further action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not schedule additional interviews if no immediate fit is identified; communicate expected two-week review timeline to applicant and forward documentation to Personnel Division for follow-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform congressional office of preliminary action and final decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Will inform the congressional office concerned of the above preliminary action and of the final decision when such decision has been made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the referring congressional office apprised both of initial steps taken and the ultimate employment decision to maintain transparency and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate action on other personnel matters and inform congressional office
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinate action on other types of personnel matters to insure expeditious completion and inform the congressional office concerned of action taken.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legislative Liaison should coordinate across personnel functions to resolve related issues quickly and proactively notify the congressional office of outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure personal interview by Procurement Section chief or deputy
rubrics_metrics.description: Issue necessary instructions to the Chief of his Procurement Section to insure personal interview by himself or his deputy where interviews are arranged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an interview is arranged, it must be conducted by the Procurement Section chief or his deputy to ensure authoritative evaluation; Personnel Division must issue the required internal instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process Form 57 expeditiously and furnish basis for final reply within 14 days
rubrics_metrics.description: Insure that Forms 57 in these cases, regardless of whether an interview has been necessary, are processed expeditiously and basis for final reply furnished the Legislative Liaison Division within 14 days in each cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fourteen-day processing requirement: Personnel Division must provide Legislative Liaison with the factual/decision basis for a final reply within 14 days to meet the timeline for congressional inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform applicant within 14 days if no suitable position exists
rubrics_metrics.description: Insure that applicant is informed within 14 days if no suitable position exists currently for his employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must receive notice within 14 days when there is no current vacancy suitable for their qualifications; this mirrors the internal 14-day timeliness standard for responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide expeditious assistance to Legislative Liaison for other personnel cases
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide expeditious assistance to the Legislative Liaison Division in other types of personnel cases to enable prompt and intelligent replies to be made to congressional offices in each case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personnel Division should support Legislative Liaison with timely information and actions across a range of personnel matters so that responses to congressional offices are accurate and prompt.
